content.short: Dolomite is a next-gen money market and DEX on Mantle enabling borrowing, lending, trading, and leveraged yield farming from a single collateral pool.
content.description: Dolomite is an innovative DeFi protocol on Mantle that combines a money market with a DEX to create a unified platform for advanced yield strategies, allowing users to lend assets, borrow against collateral, trade tokens, and farm with leverage  all using the same deposited collateral. This capital-efficient architecture eliminates the need to move funds between protocols and maximizes the utility of every deposited dollar. Dolomite supports both blue-chip and long-tail DeFi assets on Mantle.
